### coi-serviceworker

- Uses a service worker to add COOP/COEP headers, so that SharedArrayBuffer is available, and to allow PWA installation (SAB is not currently in use here). https://web.dev/articles/coop-coep

### jquery

- Popular utility library. Note that the file `jquery.d.ts` is not included in the real jQuery source; it's added here for type checking.

### sync-message

- To synchronously receive messages from the main thread from within a worker.

### v86

- Virtual machine in the browser.

### worker-webrtc

- Polyfill for using WebRTC in workers.
